title: Register a business name
timing: Before opening; certificate validity is five years.
steps: Apply through DTI BNRS New Registration and review the details.
Select territorial scope and pay the applicable registration fee plus documentary stamp tax.
Keep the business name certificate for barangay and local permit applications.

title: Get barangay business clearance
timing: Before applying for the local business permit; details vary by barangay.
steps: Apply at the barangay where the business is located.
Submit the DTI certificate, proof of right to occupy the premises and a government ID.
Pay the local fee and keep the official receipt.
documents: Proof of right to occupy premises

title: Apply for a business permit
timing: Before operations; fees and requirements depend on the city or municipality.
steps: Prepare business registration and the basis for computing local fees.
Prepare occupancy permit if required, lease contract if renting, and barangay clearance as applicable.
File with the concerned local government unit.
documents: Basis for local taxes and fees

title: Register with BIR
timing: At the registration stage; confirm filing method and requirements with the assigned RDO.
steps: Use the available online registration route or file BIR Form 1901 at the assigned RDO.
For manual filing, prepare a government ID and the required invoice option.
Check the certificate of registration and the tax types assigned to the business.
documents: BIR Form 1901 for manual individual registration
Invoice sample or BIR printed invoice option

title: Register the employer and employees
timing: When hiring staff; registration itself is generally one-time.
steps: Get an SSS employer number through the available portal or SSS branch.
For manual filing prepare Form R-1 and business identification.
Report employees and ensure they have SS numbers.
documents: Employer Registration Form R-1 when filing manually

title: Register employer and employees
timing: When hiring staff; registration itself is generally one-time.
steps: Register the employer with PhilHealth.
Report newly hired employees and arrange premium remittance.

title: Register as an employer
timing: When hiring staff; registration itself is generally one-time.
steps: Register the employer with Pag-IBIG Fund.
Prepare employee membership details for subsequent remittances.

title: Renew the business name
timing: Business name certificates have a five-year validity; check the actual expiry and renewal window.
steps: Open DTI BNRS Renewal.
Review the registered details and submit renewal.
Pay the applicable renewal fee.

title: Renew barangay clearance
timing: Follow the applicable barangay ordinance and renewal period.
steps: Confirm renewal requirements and fees with the local barangay.
Submit the required business documents and pay the assessed charges.
documents: Existing clearance and locally required supporting papers

title: Renew the local business permit
timing: Typically during the first month of the year or as provided by the issuing LGU; verify locally.
steps: Prepare the basis for computing local taxes and fees, such as income tax returns.
Submit renewed barangay clearance and other local requirements.
Pay the assessment and retain the renewed permit.
documents: Basis for local taxes and fees

title: File the applicable tax returns
timing: Income tax is commonly annual and quarterly; exact forms and schedules depend on taxpayer classification and registration.
steps: Confirm registered tax types on the BIR certificate of registration.
Determine the applicable income, VAT or percentage, and withholding tax returns.
File required returns and pay tax due by the applicable deadlines.

title: Remit SSS and EC contributions
timing: Monthly; exact payment schedule depends on current SSS rules.
steps: Compute the employer and employee SSS shares and employer EC contribution.
Remit the amounts through an accepted channel and keep proof of payment.

title: Remit PhilHealth premiums
timing: Monthly; confirm current remittance and reporting schedule.
steps: Compute employer and employee premium shares.
Remit premiums and submit required reports.

title: Remit Pag-IBIG savings
timing: Monthly; confirm current remittance and reporting schedule.
steps: Compute employer and employee membership savings.
Remit savings and submit the Membership Savings Remittance Form as required.
